name: FolderVitrine
soft_passes: #2 folder mass base-heavy/below optical centre, rebalanced by protruding card
#10 variant robustness inferred not verified — clear-frost leans on the near-white backdrop, tinted/dark contrast collapse can't be ruled out
failures: #4 16px squint: collapses to a featureless pale-blue frosted square, folder/card/sun all smear; only the orange sun dot survives at 32px
#7 figure-ground: folder #D0EBFC on base #FEFEFE far under 3:1, deepest blue only #82D3FF, folder vanishes in grayscale — root cause of #4

palette.background: ramp #FEFEFE->#EFF6FF (frosted near-white, faint cool tint, #FFFFFF rim specular)

light_model: soft top-down / environmental glass; uniform frosted base glow, folder ramps light-top to blue-pool-base, single white specular on upper-right squircle rim, internal shadows very short/soft
layer_stack: photo/media card (white glass + warm sun + blue mountains glyph)
folder front flap (pale->sky-blue glass, half-covering the card)
devices: glass vitrine (frosted squircle as a display case you look into)
folder-that-previews-its-media (photo card poking out = the app's Quick Look function)
single warm jewel (orange sun) in an all-cool frost
double-plane folder with content card z-sandwiched between back and flap
rhymes_hint: clear-glass Liquid-Glass icons at full translucency; near-monochrome frost + one warm jewel; Big-Sur folder-object lineage (Finder/Preview-adjacent) re-rendered as frosted glass
notes: Source is a 1200x630 JPEG web render (App-Store-OG style), icon centred at ~360x360px on a #F8F8F8 plate — NOT a native 1024 export; all hex is (estimated) off a compressed render. The render's drop shadow is macapp.supply's, not the icon's. 16px/32px squint run on the upsampled crop, but the failure is structural (pale-on-pale) so it holds at any resolution. No layered source to confirm full-bleed square layers — only that composition respects the mask. Beautiful-at-1024, illegible-at-16: the clear-frost aesthetic that makes the brand elegant costs it the two checks (#4, #7) the system actually enforces. Strong palette coherence with cover (blue glass + one orange accent).
